categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Adds a periodic GitHub Actions workflow and helper scripts in `.github/` to build and test PRs merged with master.
categories.rationale: Automates detection of semantic conflicts where pull requests merge cleanly in git but fail to build or pass tests against master. This reduces contributor and maintainer friction, providing useful CI tooling without addressing critical release integrity or platform breakages.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Carries the Tests label and adds automated test orchestration across open pull requests.
categories.rationale: Provides a periodic test-run mechanism across candidate merge commits to catch regressions before merge. While it executes existing test suites rather than modifying test harnesses or frameworks under `test/`, it adds useful automated testing capabilities.
